title: Capture counters
description: Totals since the archive started, except buffered, a level. At every instant received = committed + rejected + buffered + dropped.

received.description: Captures in appends the archive accepted, counted at acceptance: the moment it can no longer answer unavailable (section 4).

stubbed.description: Of committed, the captures stored as a stub (payload over the limit). Never more than committed.

buffered.description: A level: captures the archive accepted and has not yet answered, now. A synchronous archive, which accepts at its commit, reports 0; the lag before it is its producer's.

dropped.description: Captures the archive accepted and then lost while it kept running (an archive that sheds its own buffer). A producer's own shed captures are the producer's, never counted here. A crash's loss is not counted: counters start at zero; the producer sees no result. A conforming archive that never drops reports 0.

oldest_buffered_ms.description: How long the oldest buffered capture has waited: the lag.
